title: PyPI Failure Operations
description: DLQ publication, durable persistence, and infrastructure backpressure are shown as separate states.

panels.title: Unresolved failure occurrences
panels.description: Every persisted occurrence remains visible, including its Redpanda coordinates and trace context.

targets.rawSql: SELECT last_failed_at AS time, failure_id, failure_fingerprint, event_key, stage, error_class, retryable, attempt_count, snapshot_truncated AS evidence_truncated, source_topic, source_partition, source_offset, analysis_trace_id FROM failure_occurrence_summaries WHERE resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY last_failed_at DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Unresolved fingerprint groups
panels.description: Groups repeated occurrences without hiding the individual rows above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT failure_fingerprint, stage, error_class, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count, MIN(first_failed_at) AS first_seen, MAX(last_failed_at) AS last_seen FROM failure_occurrence_summaries WHERE resolved_at IS NULL GROUP BY failure_fingerprint, stage, error_class ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 250

panels.title: Failure occurrence rate by stage and class
panels.description: Counts persisted failure occurrences by their first failure time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(first_failed_at, '5m'), stage || ' / ' || error_class AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM failure_occurrence_summaries WHERE $__timeFilter(first_failed_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Truncated evidence occurrences
panels.description: Occurrences whose diagnostic snapshot reached the 256 KiB capture bound; full hashes and byte counts remain stored.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM failure_occurrence_summaries WHERE snapshot_truncated AND $__timeFilter(last_failed_at)

panels.title: DLQ routing decisions (5m)
panels.description: Valid record-level failure envelopes entering the DLQ path before broker acknowledgement. Persistence is reported separately.

panels.title: Source infrastructure backpressure (5m)
panels.description: The ready-minus-acknowledged gap is the authoritative pending-delivery signal. Output and connection failures remain diagnostic and never increment the DLQ counter.

panels.title: Persisted failure occurrences
panels.description: Safely persisted terminal failures that are durably stored and idempotently replayable; offset acknowledgement may follow the database commit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM failure_occurrence_summaries WHERE $__timeFilter(last_failed_at)
